subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: Should maintainers accept this PR's optional currentAttemptReplayMetadata attempt-result contract and retry-before-failover behavior for classified empty server_error turns once real runner/gateway proof is added?
rationale: The code shape is narrow, but it changes retry semantics across session state, message delivery, provider failover ordering, and harness result shape; automation should not infer that product/compatibility acceptance from tests alone.

options.title: Accept after proof and rebase
options.body: Require redacted real runner or gateway proof plus a current-main refresh, then review this branch as the canonical fix.

options.title: Prefer a sibling candidate
options.body: Choose a competing open PR for the same canonical issue and ask this branch to preserve any useful tests there instead.

options.title: Pause for API redesign
options.body: Reject adding the optional attempt-result field until maintainers choose a different current-attempt side-effect signal.

recommendation.title: Accept after proof and rebase
recommendation.body: Require redacted real runner or gateway proof plus a current-main refresh, then review this branch as the canonical fix.
